subtopics.content: Prescribed Shakespearean play, African plays, and Non-African plays
subtopics.objective: Analyze plot, themes, characterization, setting, dramatic techniques, and imagery in Shakespeare's *Antony and Cleopatra*; evaluate prescribed African drama (*Once Upon an Elephant* by Bosede Ademilua-Afolayan, *The Marriage of Anansewa* by Efua Sutherland); study prescribed non-African drama (*An Inspector Calls* by J. B. Priestley, *A Man for All Seasons* by Robert Bolt).

subtopics.content: Prescribed African prose novels and Non-African prose novels
subtopics.objective: Analyze narrative structure, thematic concerns, characterization, and point of view in prescribed African prose (*So the Path Does Not Die* by Pede Hollist, *Redemption Road* by Elma Shaw); critique prescribed non-African prose (*To Kill a Mockingbird* by Harper Lee, *Path of Lucas: The Journey He Endured* by Susanne Bellefeuille).

subtopics.content: Prescribed African poems and Non-African poems
subtopics.objective: Analyze poetic devices, tone, mood, theme, and stanzaic structure in prescribed African poems (*Once Upon a Time*, *New Tongue*, *Night*, *Not My Business*, *Hearty Garlands*, *The Breast of the Sea*); analyze prescribed non-African poems (*She Walks in Beauty*, *The Nun's Priest's Tale*, *Digging*, *Still I Rise*, *The Telephone Call*, *The Stone*).
